name: Sootsilk the Smoke Cat
blurb: Sootsilk, a black smoke cat with copper eyes, looks plain black at rest, until a breeze parts her fur and a silver undercoat shows.

name: Duskmask the Point Cat
blurb: Duskmask, an ivory point cat with a slate-grey face mask, ears, paws and tail and ice-blue eyes, slips through the hedges unseen.

name: Jumble the Tortie Cat
blurb: Jumble, a tortoiseshell cat with scrambled black and deep-gold patches, buries shiny pebbles in a spot only she knows.
